title: Tatyana Mamut (board director, compensation committee chair) on the NACD keynote — 'the NACD northern CA group chat group lit up'
summary: A sitting board director and compensation committee chair reports from the floor of the Directors Summit that Eric's keynote set the back-channel going: directors started asking what alternative corporate structures look like and how they could actually govern differently. She calls the morning a potential seismic shift in corporate governance.
blockquote: The first wake up call by Eric Ries came early, and the NACD northern CA group chat group lit up. Corporate directors are buzzing, asking “what are alternative corporate structures? and “how can we actually govern companies differently?”
